headline: Anthropic mathematician claims Claude proved the Riemann hypothesis
pages: Levent Alpoge, a mathematician who works at Anthropic, said Friday he used a non-public version of Claude over about six weeks to prove the Riemann hypothesis, a nearly 170-year-old problem about prime numbers. The claim came a day after Anthropic's stock market debut. Alpoge said the timing was unfortunate and that the claim is not tied to the listing. His proof, written in the Lean language, runs over 250,000 lines. Mathematician Terence Tao said verifying it is some way off, though a human author is available to help. If correct, it would be among the most significant proofs in history.
OpenAI has made similar claims this year, including on the Navier-Stokes equations, that remain unconfirmed. Source: BBC
